race.comment: FARCITED (1) finds the right race. Two runs back from a long break have been good, getting into third at Caulfield behind a dominant all the way winner before a sound effort last time. Out of 3yo company now but can improve again and gets Zahra on from an ideal draw. QUEEN CHRISTINE (9) is flying having won her past two dominantly. She was far too good for a decent field over this route last time and will take plenty of catching again. STAR TRIP (11) was much better second up at Sandown Hillside and should be fitter again. He's still got plety of upside and maps well with the claim. CYBER LINK (10) resumes having shown ability last time in, watch the market with Williams booked. IVAN'S HERO (6) next best first up.
